slot.subtopic: Cross product and angle between vectors
slot.brief: Use |a×b|² + (a·b)² = |a|²|b|² or dot/cross relation to find an unknown dot product given magnitudes and the cross product magnitude.

stem: Let $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$ be two vectors such that $|\vec{a}| = 2$, $|\vec{b}| = 3$ and $|\vec{a} \times \vec{b}| = \sqrt{11}$. Then $|\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}|$ is equal to

verdicts.working: Use $|\vec a|^2|\vec b|^2=|\vec a\cdot\vec b|^2+|\vec a\times\vec b|^2$. Hence $36=|\vec a\cdot\vec b|^2+11$, giving $|\vec a\cdot\vec b|=5$.

working:
$|\vec{a}\times\vec{b}|^2 + (\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b})^2 = |\vec{a}|^2|\vec{b}|^2$.
$(\sqrt{11})^2 + (\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b})^2 = 2^2 \cdot 3^2$
$\Rightarrow 11 + (\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b})^2 = 36$
$\Rightarrow (\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b})^2 = 25$
$\Rightarrow |\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b}| = 5$.

Independent check: Use $|\vec a|^2|\vec b|^2=|\vec a\cdot\vec b|^2+|\vec a\times\vec b|^2$. Hence $36=|\vec a\cdot\vec b|^2+11$, giving $|\vec a\cdot\vec b|=5$.
solution:
Use $|vec a|^2|vec b|^2=|vec a\cdotvec b|^2+|vec a\timesvec b|^2$.
$$36=|vec a\cdotvec b|^2+11\quad\Rightarrow\quad |\u0005vec a\cdot\u0005vec b|=5$$
